behavior: Managed-memory resize refusal retains viewport and schedules retry in 250ms; success redraws; newest resize supersedes old; invalid geometry not retried.
limits: Ordinary regression tests compile and exercise application logic but do not directly drive a live Surface resize/retry.
Related GPU depth pressure/frame/retry regression is recorded separately in model-resize-retention-2026-10-11.json.
Live event-loop recovery and physical HDR require unlocked desktop.
